def.micro: a set of lessons on a topic
def.short: a set of lessons about one subject, for example English or cooking
def.long: A set of lessons about one subject that you take for some weeks or months. You can take a course at a school, at a center or online.

grammar.pattern: take / do a course in something

examples.en: Aylin is taking an English course this summer.
examples.tr: Aylin bu yaz bir İngilizce kursuna gidiyor.

examples.en: Mia did a cooking course, and now she makes great pasta.
examples.tr: Mia bir yemek kursuna katıldı, artık harika makarna yapıyor.

examples.en: The online course has twelve lessons, and you can watch them at any time.
examples.tr: Online kursta on iki ders var ve onları istediğin zaman izleyebilirsin.

etymology.text: From Old French 'cours', from Latin 'cursus', a running or a race. A course is a path you follow from start to end.

tr.note: Üniversitede 'course' tek bir ders de olabilir: 'I'm taking five courses' (beş ders alıyorum). 'Of course' (elbette) ise ayrı bir kalıptır.

mistakes.wrong: I go to English course on Saturdays.
mistakes.right: I go to an English course on Saturdays.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'İngilizce kursuna gidiyorum' derken artikel yok; İngilizcede tekil sayılabilen isimden önce 'a/an' ya da 'the' gerekir.

quiz.cloze: The cooking ______ lasts six weeks, with one lesson every Tuesday.

def.short: officially put your name on the list for a course, school or university
def.long: To officially put your name on the list for a course, school or university, so that you become a student there. People enroll in a course or at a school.

grammar.pattern: enroll in a course / at a school

examples.en: Deniz enrolled in a yoga class last week.
examples.tr: Deniz geçen hafta bir yoga dersine kaydoldu.

examples.en: You can enroll online, but you need to pay before Friday.
examples.tr: İnternetten kaydolabilirsin ama cumadan önce ödeme yapman gerekiyor.

examples.en: More than 200 students enrolled at the new language school this year.
examples.tr: Bu yıl yeni dil okuluna 200'den fazla öğrenci kaydoldu.

etymology.text: From Old French 'enroller': 'en' (in) + 'rolle' (a roll, a list). To enroll was to write a name on a list.

tr.note: İngiliz yazımı 'enrol'. Günlük konuşmada 'sign up for' daha yaygındır. Okul bir öğrenciyi kaydederse 'enroll a student' denir.

quiz.cloze: Classes start in May, so you need to ______ before the end of April.

def.short: an official paper that shows you finished a course or passed a test
def.long: An official paper that shows you finished a course, passed a test or have a skill. You often get one at the end of a course.

examples.en: Grace got a certificate at the end of the course.
examples.tr: Grace kursun sonunda sertifika aldı.

examples.en: Lucas has a first aid certificate, so he can help in an emergency.
examples.tr: Lucas'ın ilk yardım sertifikası var, bu yüzden acil bir durumda yardım edebilir.

examples.en: To get the certificate, you must come to at least eight of the ten lessons.
examples.tr: Sertifikayı almak için on dersin en az sekizine katılmalısın.

etymology.text: From Medieval Latin 'certificatum', from 'certus' (sure) and 'facere' (to make): a paper that makes something sure.

tr.note: Doğum belgesi 'birth certificate' olur. Üniversite diploması için ise genelde 'degree' denir.

quiz.cloze: After the six-week course, every student gets a ______ with their name on it.

def.short: finish your studies at a school or university and get a diploma
def.long: To finish your studies at a school or university and get an official paper that shows this. You graduate from a school.

examples.en: Selin graduated from university last year.
examples.tr: Selin geçen yıl üniversiteden mezun oldu.

examples.en: Noah wants to find a job after he graduates in June.
examples.tr: Noah haziranda mezun olduktan sonra bir iş bulmak istiyor.

examples.en: My sister graduated from high school and started a cooking course in the summer.
examples.tr: Kız kardeşim liseden mezun oldu ve yazın bir yemek kursuna başladı.

etymology.text: From Medieval Latin 'graduare', to give a degree, from 'gradus', a step.

tr.note: İsim olarak 'graduate' /ˈɡrædʒuət/ 'mezun' demektir: 'I'm a university graduate.' Fiilde son hece 'eyt' diye okunur.

mistakes.wrong: I am graduated from Ankara University.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki 'mezunum' sözü 'I am' dedirtir; İngilizcede 'graduate' bir eylemdir ve geçmiş zamanla söylenir: I graduated.

quiz.cloze: Hakan studied for four years and ______ from university in 2022.

def.short: the title you get when you finish your studies at a university
def.long: The title or diploma that a university gives you when you finish your studies there. You can have a degree in a subject, like economics.

examples.en: Emma has a degree in economics.
examples.tr: Emma'nın ekonomi diploması var.

examples.en: You need a bachelor's degree for this job.
examples.tr: Bu iş için lisans diploması gerekiyor.

examples.en: Ana got her degree in May and is now looking for a job.
examples.tr: Ana mayısta diplomasını aldı ve şimdi iş arıyor.

etymology.text: From Old French 'degré', a step, from Latin 'gradus'. A university degree was seen as a step up in learning.

tr.note: Bu kartta 'üniversite diploması' anlamındadır; sıcaklık derecesi için ayrı kart var. Lisans 'bachelor's degree', yüksek lisans 'master's degree' olur.

quiz.cloze: Elif finished university last year with a ______ in biology.

def.short: the main subject that a student studies at college or university
def.long: The main subject that a student studies at college or university. This word is mostly used in the US: 'What's your major?' means 'What are you studying?'

examples.en: My major is computer science.
examples.tr: Bölümüm bilgisayar bilimleri.

examples.en: Lucas changed his major from math to music in his second year.
examples.tr: Lucas ikinci yılında bölümünü matematikten müziğe değiştirdi.

examples.en: At the party, everyone asked Grace about her major and her plans.
examples.tr: Partide herkes Grace'e bölümünü ve planlarını sordu.

etymology.text: From Latin 'maior', meaning 'bigger'. Your major is the bigger, main part of your studies.

tr.note: Türkçede 'bölüm' dendiği için 'department' demek akla gelir, ama 'department' okulun birimidir. Öğrencinin okuduğu alan için 'major' denir ya da 'What do you study?' diye sorulur.

quiz.cloze: Omar loves numbers, so he chose math as his ______ at college.

def.short: in the US, a university or a school where you study after high school
def.long: In the US, a university or a school where people study after high school. Americans often say 'go to college' for going to university.

grammar.pattern: go to college / be in college

examples.en: Noah is in his second year of college.
examples.tr: Noah üniversitenin ikinci sınıfında.

examples.en: Deniz wants to go to college in the US and study art.
examples.tr: Deniz ABD'de üniversiteye gidip sanat okumak istiyor.

examples.en: Kerem met his best friend in college, and they still talk every week.
examples.tr: Kerem en yakın arkadaşıyla üniversitede tanıştı ve hâlâ her hafta konuşuyorlar.

etymology.text: From Latin 'collegium', a group of people who work together.

false_friend.tr_means: özel, çoğu zaman İngilizce eğitim veren okul ya da lise

tr.note: Türkiye'deki 'kolej' genelde özel bir okul ya da lisedir; İngilizcede bu 'private school' olur. ABD'de 'college' üniversite demektir; İngiltere'de 16 yaşından sonra gidilen okul da olabilir.

quiz.cloze: After high school, Diego went to ______ in Boston to study music.

def.short: money given to a good student to pay for school, which they do not pay back
def.long: Money that a school, a company or a group gives to a student to pay for their studies. The student does not need to pay it back.

examples.en: Aylin won a scholarship to study in Canada.
examples.tr: Aylin Kanada'da okumak için burs kazandı.

examples.en: Without a scholarship, Mehmet could not pay for university.
examples.tr: Mehmet burs olmadan üniversitenin parasını ödeyemezdi.

examples.en: Sofia has good grades, so she is applying for three scholarships this year.
examples.tr: Sofia'nın notları iyi, bu yüzden bu yıl üç burs için başvuruyor.

etymology.text: From 'scholar' (a student or learned person) + '-ship'. 'Scholar' goes back to Latin 'schola', school.

tr.note: 'Scholarship' genelde başarı için verilir. İhtiyaca göre verilen paraya daha çok 'grant' denir. Geri ödenen öğrenim kredisi ise 'student loan' olur.

quiz.cloze: Ayşe's grades were so good that she got a ______ and paid nothing for college.

def.short: a person who has just started to learn or do something
def.long: A person who has just started to learn or do something, so they do not know much yet. Many courses are for beginners.

examples.en: This yoga class is for beginners.
examples.tr: Bu yoga dersi yeni başlayanlar için.

examples.en: I'm a beginner, so please speak a little more slowly.
examples.tr: Ben yeni başlayan biriyim, lütfen biraz daha yavaş konuş.

examples.en: Hakan is a complete beginner, but he practices the guitar every evening.
examples.tr: Hakan gitarda tamamen yeni başlayan biri ama her akşam pratik yapıyor.

tr.note: Sıfat gibi de kullanılır: 'beginner level' (başlangıç seviyesi).

quiz.cloze: Zeynep started tennis last week, so she is still a ______.

def.short: a person who learned a language as a child, as their first language
def.long: A person who learned a language as a small child at home, as their first language. You say 'a native speaker of English'.

examples.en: Our English teacher is a native speaker.
examples.tr: İngilizce öğretmenimizin ana dili İngilizce.

examples.en: Emma is a native speaker of English, and she helps me with my homework.
examples.tr: Emma'nın ana dili İngilizce ve ödevlerimde bana yardım ediyor.

examples.en: Practicing with native speakers online helps Sofia understand fast, everyday English.
examples.tr: Ana dili İngilizce olan kişilerle internette pratik yapmak, Sofia'nın hızlı ve günlük İngilizceyi anlamasına yardım ediyor.

tr.note: Türkçede tek kelimelik karşılığı yok. Başka diller için de kullanılır: 'a native speaker of Spanish' (ana dili İspanyolca olan biri). Karşıtı 'non-native speaker' olur.

quiz.cloze: Ali grew up in London, so he is a ______ of English.
